mutations.name: R1 the renderer stops registering, so every surface goes back to the marker while the module still exports a perfectly good render function
mutations.expectRed: the renderer is registered under kind `part-renderer`

mutations.name: R2 it registers under a lookalike name, which resolves for nobody and is invisible to any cell that compares the constant with itself
mutations.expectRed: the registered NAME is the wire kind, spelled out

mutations.name: R3 the untrusted-element guard is dropped, so one null in the events array throws and the dispatcher collapses the whole frame to a single failure line
mutations.find: const type = typeof e === "object" && e !== null ? str(e.type) : undefined;
mutations.expectRed: a null element among good events costs one line, not the frame

mutations.name: R4 the empty-versus-absent distinction collapses on the tool result, which is the exact shape the browser copy diverged on
mutations.expectRed: an EMPTY tool result renders empty, not `(no content)`

mutations.name: R5 the tail flush for an unterminated text stream is dropped, so a truncated turn is indistinguishable from a silent one
mutations.find: for (const id of [...text.keys()]) flush(text, id, TEXT_PREFIX, TEXT_PREFIX, " …");
mutations.expectRed: an unterminated text stream is flushed and marked truncated

mutations.name: R6 an event type this build does not know is skipped instead of named, which is a hole in a transcript that still looks complete
mutations.expectRed: an event type this build does not know is NAMED, not dropped

mutations.name: R7 the line-start predicate accepts everything, which turns the invariant cell vacuous and is caught only by its own control
mutations.expectRed: predicate rejects a raw block opener

mutations.name: R8 the idempotence guard is dropped, so loading this package from a second physical copy throws and takes down `cotal ext add` for every connector, which is the crash this guard was written from
mutations.expectRed: a second registration does not throw (the ext-add crash, executed)
